entities.summary: Eedris Turayo Abdulkareem Ajenifuja, known professionally as Eedris Abdulkareem, is a Nigerian singer and rapper. He was the lead rapper of the defunct Nigerian hip hop group The Remedies and is regarded as a pioneer of Nigerian hip-hop and one of its most influential rappers.
